text: Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
meaning: Your past doesn’t get the final word: God is already doing something new, even in your dry places.
kjv: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

text: “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.”
meaning: God said this to his people in exile: even in a hard season, his plans for them aimed at hope.
kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
meaning: When you can’t see the whole picture, trust God with it and invite him into every choice you make.
kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
meaning: You’re God’s handiwork, not an accident, and he’s already lined up good things for you to do.
kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

text: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
meaning: Life is short, so ask God to help you spend your days on what actually matters.
kjv: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

text: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
meaning: Paul hadn’t arrived yet either. Let go of what’s behind you and keep moving toward Jesus.
kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

text: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.
meaning: Bring your plans to God before you start; as you trust him with them, he shapes and steadies them.
kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
meaning: Forget the big show. God wants you to do what’s right, love being kind, and walk humbly with him.
kjv: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
meaning: Not everything that happens is good, but God can weave even the painful parts into something good.
kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

text: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
meaning: Homework, job or chores all count: do them wholeheartedly, as if Jesus were your boss.
kjv: And what soever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men; Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

text: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
meaning: Delight in God first. As he becomes your joy, he reshapes what you long for and meets you there.
kjv: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

text: Let us acknowledge the LORD. Let us press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.
meaning: Keep pursuing God; he’s as dependable as sunrise and as refreshing as rain on dry ground.
kjv: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

text: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden. Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house. Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
meaning: Hiding your faith misses the point. The good you do can point people to God, like a city on a hill.
kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

text: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
meaning: Make your plans, but hold them loosely: God is the one guiding each step you actually take.
kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
meaning: Even your desire to do good comes from God. He’s working inside you, not just watching you.
kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

text: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
meaning: Whatever you’re good at is a gift from God, meant to be used to help the people around you.
kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
meaning: No need to figure out life by guessing: God promises to teach you and keep a caring eye on you.
kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

text: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
meaning: Jesus picked you first, on purpose, to live a life that leaves lasting good behind it.
kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

text: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
meaning: Ordinary moments like lunch can honor God when you do them with him in mind.
kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

text: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
meaning: Isaiah didn’t wait until he felt qualified. When God looks for someone, you can be the one who says yes.
kjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

text: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
meaning: A hundred plans can fill your head, but God’s purposes are the ones that stand in the end.
kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

text: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
meaning: Being young doesn’t disqualify you. How you talk, love and live can set the example for others.
kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

text: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
meaning: In time, God makes things beautiful, and that ache for forever inside you is something he put there.
kjv: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

text: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
meaning: A thief only takes and destroys, but Jesus came to give you a full, rich life with him.
kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

text: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
meaning: What God starts in you, he finishes. It rests on his faithfulness, not on your strength.
kjv: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
meaning: Worship isn’t just singing. It’s giving God your whole everyday life because of his mercy.
kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
meaning: Here’s the heart of it all: God loved you so much he gave his Son, so trusting him means life forever.
kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

text: We love him, because he first loved us.
meaning: Loving God is a response: he loved you long before you ever thought about loving him.
kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.

text: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.”
meaning: There’s no expiration date on God’s love for you, and his kindness keeps drawing you near.
kjv: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

text: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
meaning: No cleaning up required first: Jesus died for you while you were still at your worst.
kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

text: Let all that you do be done in love.
meaning: Before you speak, post or act, ask yourself one simple question: is this coming from love?
kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.

text: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
meaning: Picture this: God isn’t just putting up with you. He’s near, he calms your fears and sings over you.
kjv: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

text: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
meaning: The Father’s love for Jesus is the same love Jesus has for you. Stay close and live in it.
kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

text: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
meaning: Nothing this life offers compares with God’s love, so praise comes naturally once you taste it.
kjv: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

text: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
meaning: Since love comes from God, loving people well is one of the clearest signs you really know him.
kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God. He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

text: Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
meaning: A mother forgetting her baby is almost unthinkable, yet God says he’ll never forget you.
kjv: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

text: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
meaning: Let Jesus’s self-giving love be your pattern: love that costs you something, freely given.
kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
meaning: How Christians love each other is meant to be the thing that shows the world who Jesus is.
kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another. By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

text: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
meaning: Like chicks tucked under a bird’s wings, you can run to God’s love and find shelter there.
kjv: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

text: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
meaning: Nice words are easy. Real love shows up in what you actually do, with honesty and action.
kjv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

text: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
meaning: Life, death, powers, the future: none of it can cut you off from God’s love in Jesus.
kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
meaning: Wear kindness and honesty like a necklace you never take off; let them become who you are.
kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

text: This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
meaning: Jesus showed the highest love by giving his life. Loving friends means putting them before yourself.
kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you. Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

text: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
meaning: Love didn’t start with us reaching God. It started with God reaching us through Jesus.
kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

text: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
meaning: Faith and hope matter, but love outlasts everything. It’s the thing that counts most.
kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

text: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
meaning: Fake love isn’t love. Be genuine, hate what’s truly wrong, and hold tight to what’s good.
kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

text: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
meaning: Every other good quality is held together by love. Without it, the rest falls apart.
kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

text: “For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.
meaning: Mountains look permanent, yet God says his kindness toward you is even more solid than they are.
kjv: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

text: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
meaning: Be serious about loving people. Real love doesn’t keep score; it’s quick to forgive.
kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

text: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness. The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
meaning: Patient, kind, slow to get angry: that’s who God is, and his goodness reaches everyone.
kjv: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy. The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
meaning: Hired hands run when danger comes. Jesus is the shepherd who gave his life to protect you.
kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

text: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
meaning: Love isn’t just something God does; it’s who he is. Living in love keeps you close to him.
kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

text: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
meaning: Don’t let the culture shape you by default. Let God reshape how you think, and you’ll see his will.
kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

text: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
meaning: A prayer for scrolling days: God, pull my eyes off what’s empty and bring me back to life.
kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

text: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
meaning: Guard your heart carefully. What you let into it shapes everything you say and do.
kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

text: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
meaning: Just because something’s allowed doesn’t mean it’s good for you. Don’t let anything own you.
kjv: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.

text: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
meaning: Prayer isn’t a performance. Find a quiet place and talk to God honestly; he sees and cares.
kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.
meaning: What you dwell on shapes you. Fill your mind with what’s true, good and beautiful.
kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

text: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
meaning: Temptation hits everyone, and you’re not stuck. God is faithful and will show you a way out.
kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
meaning: Lift your eyes past the daily noise. Keep your focus on God and what lasts forever.
kjv: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

text: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
meaning: Jesus said this to sleepy friends: wanting to do right isn’t enough, so stay alert and pray.
kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
meaning: These qualities aren’t a to-do list you force. They grow in you as God’s Spirit works in you.
kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
meaning: Ask God to make your words and even your private thoughts something he’s glad to hear.
kjv: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

text: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise; redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
meaning: Time is a gift, so use it on purpose. Each day is a chance to do good, so don’t drift through it.
kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise, Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

text: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you. Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
meaning: Stop looking at every distraction. Fix your eyes on the right path and walk it steadily.
kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee. Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.
meaning: Stuck on a decision? Ask God for wisdom. He gives generously and never shames you for asking.
kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

text: The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
meaning: Eyes work like windows: what you keep looking at fills your whole life with light or with darkness.
kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

text: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
meaning: Controlling your temper takes more strength than winning a fight. Real power is self-control.
kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

text: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win. Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
meaning: Athletes train hard for a trophy that rusts. Train your life with discipline for what lasts forever.
kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain. And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
meaning: Scripture rarely shows the whole road at once, but it lights up the next step in front of you.
kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
meaning: Beating wrong cravings takes more than willpower: it means staying in step with God’s Spirit.
kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
meaning: Listen first, talk second, and cool down before reacting. Anger rarely makes things right.
kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

text: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
meaning: Spoken to Joshua as he led Israel: keep God’s word in your mind and live it out, and you’ll walk wisely.
kjv: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

text: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
meaning: Fame, money, followers: none of it is worth losing your soul. Keep first things first.
kjv: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

text: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
meaning: Without self-control, you’re like a city with no walls, open to anything that wants to get in.
kjv: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

text: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
meaning: Stay clear-headed. Evil is real and looking for weak moments, so keep your guard up.
kjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

text: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.
meaning: Discipline hurts in the moment, but it grows peace and goodness in you later on.
kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

text: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
meaning: Asking God to search your heart takes courage: let him show you what’s wrong and lead you right.
kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
meaning: Honest confession meets a faithful God: he forgives you and washes you completely clean.
kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
meaning: David prayed this after a huge failure. You can ask God for a fresh heart, not just a fresh start.
kjv: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

text: “Come now, and let us reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.”
meaning: No stain is too deep. God invites you to come talk, and he can make you completely clean.
kjv: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

text: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
meaning: You’ve been forgiven so much by God. Let that make you kind and quick to forgive others.
kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
meaning: East and west never meet. That’s how far God has removed your forgiven sins from you.
kjv: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

text: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
meaning: Holding grudges isn’t God’s style. Mercy isn’t a chore for him; it’s what he delights in.
kjv: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
meaning: Forgiving others and receiving God’s forgiveness go together. Letting go keeps your heart open.
kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

text: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
meaning: If you belong to Jesus, God isn’t condemning you. Guilt doesn’t get to define you anymore.
kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

text: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
meaning: Wiping your record clean, God chooses not to bring it back up. That’s how deep his mercy goes.
kjv: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

text: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
meaning: Treat people with mercy instead of judgment. Letting others off the hook frees you too.
kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
meaning: God isn’t reluctant to forgive. He’s ready and eager, full of love for anyone who calls to him.
kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

text: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
meaning: Hiding sin keeps you stuck. Owning it and turning from it is where mercy finds you.
kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

text: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
meaning: Grudges and prayer don’t mix. Let go of what you hold against others, since you need forgiveness too.
kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

text: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
meaning: Come to God boldly, not sneaking in. You’ll find mercy and help right when you need it.
kjv: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

text: He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
meaning: The father ran to his returning son. That’s how God responds when you turn back toward him.
kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

text: Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
meaning: Torn clothes were a show of grief. God wants your real heart instead, and he’s quick to show mercy.
kjv: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
meaning: Like morning fog burning off, your sins are gone. God has already paid to bring you back, so come home.
kjv: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

text: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
meaning: Showing mercy to others keeps you living in the same mercy God pours out on you.
kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

text: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
meaning: Wisdom keeps you calm. Letting a slight go instead of getting even is something to be proud of.
kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

text: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
meaning: Struggles grow in secret. Confess to people you trust and pray for each other; prayer really matters.
kjv: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

text: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
meaning: When your faith feels dull, ask God to bring back the joy and give you a willing heart again.
kjv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

text: Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
meaning: Mercy received should become mercy given: treat others the way your Father has treated you.
kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

text: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
meaning: Hate keeps the fight going. Love chooses to cover wrongs instead of broadcasting them.
kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

text: Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
meaning: Real happiness is knowing your wrongs are forgiven and covered by God, not just hidden.
kjv: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
meaning: Pointing fingers at the world wasn’t why Jesus came. He came to rescue it.
kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

text: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
meaning: Jesus took the punishment we deserved, so we could have peace with God and be made whole.
kjv: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

text: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
meaning: Empty tomb, kept promise: Jesus rose just like he said, which means his words can be trusted.
kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
meaning: To a grieving Martha, Jesus says death isn’t the end for those who trust him, and he asks you too.
kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

text: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
meaning: In the middle of losing everything, Job still held on: his Redeemer lives and will have the last word.
kjv: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
meaning: Sin and death don’t win. Through Jesus, God hands you a victory you couldn’t earn yourself.
kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
meaning: Yesterday’s failures don’t use up God’s mercy. Every morning, it’s new and waiting for you.
kjv: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
meaning: A blessing for you: as you trust God, may he fill you with joy and peace until hope overflows.
kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
meaning: Hard nights don’t last forever. God’s goodness outlasts the pain, and joy comes with the morning.
kjv: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

text: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
meaning: Broken things aren’t the end of the story. God is making all things new, and his word is sure.
kjv: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

text: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you. You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
meaning: Wholehearted seeking is never wasted: call on God and look for him, and you’ll find he listens.
kjv: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you. And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
meaning: Trusting God means being sure of what he’s promised, even when you can’t see it yet.
kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

text: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
meaning: Paul knew real pain, yet said what’s coming with God is so great it outweighs today’s suffering.
kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
meaning: It’s okay to ask your own soul why it’s down. Then remind yourself: put your hope in God.
kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

text: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.
meaning: Trends fade and everything wears out, but what God says stays true forever.
kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

text: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you. If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
meaning: In the Father’s house there’s room for you, and Jesus promises to come back so you can be with him.
kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you. And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

text: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.
meaning: Said to Mary about something that seemed impossible: when God speaks, nothing can stop it.
kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

text: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
meaning: After losing almost everything, the writer decides God himself is enough, and that’s a reason to hope.
kjv: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

text: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
meaning: People may let you down, but you can keep watching for God and wait for him: he hears you.
kjv: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
meaning: Your tears aren’t wasted. What you plant in hard seasons, God can turn into a harvest of joy.
kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

text: Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.
meaning: Putting your trust in God, not in luck or people, is where real security and blessing begin.
kjv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

text: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
meaning: Your body may get tired and older, but God keeps renewing the inside of you, one day at a time.
kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

text: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
meaning: Some things are beyond human effort, like changing a heart, but nothing is beyond God’s power.
kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

text: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
meaning: Don’t envy people who cut corners. Living God’s way has a real future, and your hope won’t be wasted.
kjv: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

text: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
meaning: Better than anything you could picture: that’s what God has ready for those who love him.
kjv: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.

text: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
meaning: Life will be hard at times, but Jesus has already won, so you can have peace by staying close to him.
kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living. Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
meaning: Even while you wait, you can expect to see God’s goodness in this life. Hold on and take heart.
kjv: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living. Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.
meaning: One day God will end all pain and grief for good. Today’s tears are not the end of your story.
kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
meaning: In Christ, your past doesn’t define you anymore. God gives you a fresh start and a new life.
kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

text: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
meaning: You weren’t an accident or a mistake. God made you with care, and that’s a reason to thank him.
kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

text: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
meaning: Being called God’s child is a huge gift of love, even when the world doesn’t understand you.
kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

text: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
meaning: Your life now runs on trust in Jesus, who loved you enough to give himself up for you.
kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

text: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.
meaning: You’re already God’s child, and the best is still ahead: one day you’ll see him and be like him.
kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

text: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
meaning: Jesus doesn’t treat you like hired help. He calls you his friend and lets you in on what matters.
kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

text: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
meaning: Before anyone met you, God was shaping every part of you. You were made by hand, on purpose.
kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.

text: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
meaning: Trusting Jesus makes you part of God’s family. No background or past record keeps you out.
kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

text: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
meaning: Trouble can’t cut you off from Christ’s love, and through him you come out stronger than what you face.
kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

text: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
meaning: God knows you down to the last hair on your head. You matter to him, so you don’t have to live afraid.
kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

text: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.”
meaning: Through Isaiah, God tells his people he made them, rescued them and calls them by name. You belong.
kjv: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

text: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
meaning: Like a branch on a vine, your life grows best when you stay connected to Jesus every day.
kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

text: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own, for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
meaning: Your body matters to God. He lives in you and paid a high price for you, so honor him with how you live.
kjv: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

text: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
meaning: Every person, man or woman, carries God’s image. That gives you, and everyone around you, real worth.
kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

text: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
meaning: Real freedom isn’t doing whatever you want. It’s being set free by Jesus from what holds you down.
kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

text: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
meaning: You didn’t make yourself. God did, and like a shepherd with his sheep, he looks after what’s his.
kjv: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

text: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
meaning: No need to come to God in fear. His Spirit makes you his child, so you can run to him like a loving dad.
kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

text: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
meaning: Who you really are is safely held with Christ, not decided by likes, looks or what others say.
kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

text: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay, and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
meaning: Clay doesn’t shape itself. You can trust God, the potter, to shape your life with care.
kjv: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
meaning: Jesus knows his people and they listen for his voice. He gives them life that lasts and holds them tight.
kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

text: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
meaning: Together, followers of Jesus form his body, and you have a part to play that no one else can fill.
kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

text: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
meaning: Christ made you free. Don’t slide back into the old chains of trying to earn your way to God.
kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

text: Don’t you know that you are a temple of God, and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
meaning: God’s Spirit lives among his people, which makes them holy ground. Treat each other with care.
kjv: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

text: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
meaning: As you keep looking to Jesus, God’s Spirit slowly changes you to be more like him, step by step.
kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

text: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
meaning: Becoming God’s child isn’t about your family or your effort. It’s a gift to all who welcome Jesus.
kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
meaning: Jesus doesn’t force his way in. He knocks and waits, wanting a real, close friendship with you.
kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

text: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
meaning: If you’re worn out, Jesus invites you to come as you are. His way is gentle and gives your soul rest.
kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

text: The LORD is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
meaning: With God as your shepherd, you have what you truly need. He knows when to slow you down and refresh you.
kjv: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

text: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
meaning: God promised Moses he would go with him. His presence is what turns a hard road into a place of rest.
kjv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

text: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.
meaning: Pause the noise for a minute. God is God, and he’s in charge even when life feels out of control.
kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

text: He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
meaning: Even Jesus told his busy friends to get away and rest. Taking a break isn’t lazy, it’s wise.
kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
meaning: Real rest comes from leaning on God alone, not on your plans, your phone or other people’s approval.
kjv: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David. Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
meaning: When you walk in God’s wisdom, you can lie down without dread and let yourself sleep in peace.
kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

text: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done. God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
meaning: After creating, God rested, not because he was tired, but to show that rest is good and holy.
kjv: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made. And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
meaning: Grinding nonstop won’t hold your life together. God cares for you, and sleep is one of his gifts.
kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

text: For, behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone. The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
meaning: In this love song, winter gives way to spring. Hard seasons end, and new life shows up again.
kjv: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone; The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;

text: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
meaning: Busy can crowd out what matters most. Like Mary, choose time with Jesus first; it’s never wasted.
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
meaning: Drained and sad? God sees it, and he’s the one who can truly fill you back up.
kjv: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
meaning: You can rest at night not because everything is solved, but because God is watching over you.
kjv: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

text: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
meaning: Like a gentle shepherd, God carries the weak close and never rushes those who struggle.
kjv: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

text: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
meaning: A little with peace beats a lot with stress. Chasing more and more often just leaves you empty.
kjv: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.

text: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.
meaning: Even when crowds wanted him, Jesus made time to slip away and pray. You need quiet time too.
kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

text: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.
meaning: At the sea, God told his people to stop panicking and watch him work. Some battles are his to fight.
kjv: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

text: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
meaning: Living with deep respect for God leads to a full life and a settled heart that can truly rest.
kjv: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

text: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God. For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
meaning: God offers a deeper rest, where you stop trying to earn his love and trust what he has already done.
kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God. For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
meaning: You can quiet your racing mind and rest near God, like a child calm in a parent’s arms.
kjv: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

text: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.”
meaning: Rest is God’s gift for your good, not a rule to stress over. He made it to help you, not trap you.
kjv: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

text: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places.
meaning: Safe homes and quiet resting places: that’s the future God pictures for his people.
kjv: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

text: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
meaning: Waiting on God quietly isn’t giving up. It’s trusting he will rescue in his time, even when it’s slow.
kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

text: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
meaning: A plain meal in a peaceful home beats a feast full of fighting. Peace is worth more than plenty.
kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

text: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
meaning: After a huge day with crowds, Jesus went off alone to pray. Time alone with God can recharge you.
kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

text: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.
meaning: Having a little while you honor God beats being rich and stressed. Money can’t buy a calm heart.
kjv: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.

text: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
meaning: God told Joshua to be brave because he’d be with him everywhere. Courage grows when you know you’re not alone.
kjv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

text: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
meaning: God doesn’t leave you alone in fear. He promises to be with you, give you strength and hold you up.
kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

text: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
meaning: When God is your light and your safe place, the things that scare you get a whole lot smaller.
kjv: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
meaning: Fear isn’t from God. His Spirit gives you courage, love and the self-control to stay steady.
kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

text: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.
meaning: Moses reminded Joshua that God goes ahead of him. Wherever you’re headed, God is already there.
kjv: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

text: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
meaning: On a dark, stormy lake, Jesus came near and told his scared friends who he was. His presence calms fear.
kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

text: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
meaning: With God on your side, no opposition gets the final say. His love outweighs anything against you.
kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
meaning: Feeling afraid isn’t failure. The move is to take that fear straight to God and choose to trust him.
kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee. In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
meaning: God doesn’t promise you’ll skip hard times, but he promises to be with you all the way through them.
kjv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

text: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
meaning: Worrying about what people think can trap you. Trusting God sets you free and keeps you safe.
kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.

text: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
meaning: Since God is your helper, people’s threats and opinions don’t have to run your life.
kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

text: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
meaning: Stay alert, hold on to your faith and be brave. This short pep talk still fits a hard day.
kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
meaning: Even in your darkest valley, you’re not walking alone. God is right there, guiding and comforting you.
kjv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

text: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
meaning: Picture God taking your hand and telling you not to fear. His help is that close and that personal.
kjv: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
meaning: God’s love isn’t waiting to punish you. The more you know that love, the more fear loses its hold.
kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

text: I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?
meaning: Why fear people who won’t last forever? The God who comforts you is far bigger than any of them.
kjv: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;

text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
meaning: Before a huge challenge, Israel heard this: be strong, because God goes with you and won’t abandon you.
kjv: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

text: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
meaning: When God is on your side, other people’s power over you shrinks. You can face them without panic.
kjv: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

text: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
meaning: Your Father isn’t stingy. He’s glad to give you his kingdom, so you don’t need to cling to worry.
kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
meaning: Don’t give up the confidence you have in God. Holding on to your faith is worth it in the end.
kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

text: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be disappointed.
meaning: Because God helps you, you can be determined: set your face and keep going without shame.
kjv: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

text: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
meaning: God’s Spirit in you is greater than anything in the world trying to pull you away from the truth.
kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
meaning: Bad news can still come, but a heart anchored in God doesn’t have to fall apart when it does.
kjv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

text: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
meaning: Sudden scares don’t have to rule you. God can be your confidence and keep you from getting trapped.
kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh. For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

text: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
meaning: When his friends lay face down in terror, Jesus touched them and told them to get up. He lifts you too.
kjv: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

text: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.
meaning: Again and again God has shown he’s faithful. There’s no other rock like him to stand on.
kjv: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.

text: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
meaning: Paul learned that Christ gives strength for every situation, whether you have a lot or almost nothing.
kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

text: But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
meaning: When you’re running on empty, hoping in God renews you, so you can keep going without burning out.
kjv: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
meaning: Trouble isn’t a sign God is far away. He’s a safe place and your strength, right there in the moment.
kjv: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

text: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
meaning: You don’t have to be strong all the time. God’s grace is enough, and his power shows up in your weak spots.
kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

text: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
meaning: Feeling like you’ve got nothing left? God loves to give strength to people who are worn out.
kjv: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

text: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
meaning: You weren’t meant to be strong on your own. Lean on God’s mighty strength, not just your willpower.
kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
meaning: When you look around for help, remember the one who made everything is the one who helps you.
kjv: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

text: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
meaning: Doing good can feel thankless, but keep going. In time it will bear fruit, so don’t quit.
kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

text: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance. Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
meaning: You can face hard tests with joy, because they build endurance that grows you into someone whole.
kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

text: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
