meaning: Think of God as a strong tower you can run to. When life feels unsafe, he’s the place to go.
kjv: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
meaning: Your body and feelings will fail sometimes, but God stays your strength, and he is yours forever.
kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

text: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
meaning: Suffering is real, but it won’t last forever, and God is the one who restores you and makes you strong.
kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

text: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, The Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
meaning: You get tired, but God never does. He never runs out of energy or understanding for you.
kjv: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.

text: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.
meaning: You’re like an ordinary clay jar holding a treasure. Your weakness shows the power comes from God.
kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

text: For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food; the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
meaning: Even when everything goes wrong and nothing works out, you can still find joy in God himself.
kjv: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

text: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
meaning: Trusting God and seeing him help you leads to gratitude. Let your heart sing about what he’s done.
kjv: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

text: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
meaning: When you don’t even know what to pray, God’s Spirit prays for you, even through your sighs.
kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

text: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
meaning: David called God his fortress after years of danger. God is the one who steadies the road you walk.
kjv: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

text: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.
meaning: Holding on when you’re tempted or tested is worth it. God promises real life to those who love him.
kjv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

text: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
meaning: Don’t just seek God in emergencies. Keep looking for him and his strength every single day.
kjv: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

text: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
meaning: Hardships and setbacks can push you to depend on Christ, and that dependence is where real strength is.
kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

text: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
meaning: A woman who honors God wears strength and dignity like clothes, and she can smile at the future.
kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

text: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
meaning: Ask God for strength each morning, not just once. Every new day you can lean on him again.
kjv: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.
meaning: God is faithful. He will make you steady and guard you from the evil one, even when people let you down.
kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

text: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
meaning: Like a father to a son, Paul tells Timothy to draw strength from Jesus’ grace, not from trying harder.
kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
meaning: Keep going and stay steady. Nothing you do for God is wasted, even when no one else notices.
kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
meaning: Instead of spiraling, turn each worry into a prayer with thanks. God’s peace will guard your heart and mind.
kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time; casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
meaning: You don’t have to carry every worry alone. Hand them to God, because he truly cares about you.
kjv: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

text: Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
meaning: Give God the heavy stuff you’re carrying. He promises to keep you going and keep you standing.
kjv: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

text: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
meaning: Live one day at a time. Tomorrow has its own problems, so don’t borrow its worries today.
kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

text: Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
meaning: On his last night with his friends, Jesus told them not to panic but to trust him. That still holds.
kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
meaning: When your mind is racing with a hundred thoughts, God’s comfort can still bring your soul real joy.
kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

text: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
meaning: Your life is about more than food, clothes or looks. God cares for you, so worry doesn’t have to run you.
kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

text: Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.
meaning: God invited Jeremiah, locked up in prison, to call out to him. You can bring your questions to him too.
kjv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

text: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
meaning: Anxiety is heavy, and one kind word can lift it. Be the person who speaks that word to someone today.
kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
meaning: When your heart is broken, God doesn’t keep his distance. He comes close and lifts your crushed spirit.
kjv: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

text: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
meaning: The same Jesus who hushed a raging sea can speak calm into the storm you’re in right now.
kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

text: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
meaning: Feeling fragile or almost burned out? God’s chosen servant is gentle with you and won’t crush you.
kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

text: Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
meaning: Worry can’t add a single minute to your life, so you can set it down and trust God with tomorrow.
kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
meaning: When trouble hits, the Lord is a safe place to run, and he knows each person who hides in him.
kjv: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

text: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
meaning: Jesus gets it: he faced real temptation and weakness, so he meets your struggles with understanding.
kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
meaning: When your heart is overwhelmed, even far from home, cry out and ask God to set you on solid ground.
kjv: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

text: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
meaning: Jesus promised his friends he wouldn’t leave them on their own. You aren’t abandoned either.
kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort; who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
meaning: The comfort God gives you in hard times isn’t just for you: it equips you to comfort someone else.
kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

text: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
meaning: You don’t need perfect faith to pray. Honest faith mixed with doubt is still welcome with Jesus.
kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

text: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
meaning: From your first day to your last gray hair, the One who made you promises to keep carrying you.
kjv: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.

text: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
meaning: Prayer isn’t a long shot: when you ask for what lines up with God’s will, he truly hears you.
kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

text: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
meaning: Every time you leave home and every time you come back, the Lord is watching over your life.
kjv: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

text: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
meaning: In the middle of grief, the writer called out and found God near, telling him not to fear.
kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
meaning: Everything around you changes, but Jesus doesn’t. Who he was then is who he is for you today.
kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

text: As one whom his mother comforts, so will I comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.
meaning: Picture a mother holding a hurting child: that’s how tender and close God’s comfort is.
kjv: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

text: If we are faithless, he remains faithful. For he can’t deny himself.
meaning: On days your faith runs low, God’s faithfulness doesn’t. He stays true to who he is.
kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he can not deny himself.

text: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
meaning: Writing to generous friends, Paul trusted God to meet their real needs, not every want, from his riches.
kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

text: But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
meaning: Put God and doing right first, and trust him with the rest instead of chasing it anxiously.
kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

text: Give us today our daily bread.
meaning: Jesus teaches you to bring today’s needs to God, one day at a time, without hoarding worry for later.
kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.

text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
meaning: Even strong lions go hungry, yet people who seek God won’t miss out on anything truly good for them.
kjv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.

text: Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
meaning: Keep praying and don’t give up: Jesus invites you to ask, seek and knock, trusting a Father who answers.
kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
meaning: Every good thing in your life traces back to God, and unlike shifting shadows, he never changes.
kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

text: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
meaning: If God feeds birds that never plant or store food, you can trust that you matter even more to him.
kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

text: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
meaning: Waiting isn’t wasted time: the Lord is good to people who keep looking to him while they wait.
kjv: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

text: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
meaning: You can be content without chasing more money, because God has promised never to leave you.
kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

text: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season. You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
meaning: Every living creature depends on God’s open hand, and he provides what they need in its time.
kjv: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season. Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
meaning: Grace is something God can pour out on you, so you have enough to keep doing good for others.
kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

text: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.”
meaning: Jesus is saying he fills the deep hunger in you that food, money or success never can.
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

text: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin, yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
meaning: Wildflowers don’t stress over what to wear, yet God dresses them beautifully. He cares for you too.
kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

text: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it. I know how to be humbled, and I know also how to abound. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
meaning: Contentment is something you learn: Paul found peace with plenty and with nearly nothing.
kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content. I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

text: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
meaning: Bring even ordinary needs to God in prayer: he’s the one who sends the rain that makes things grow.
kjv: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

text: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.
meaning: After the flood, God promised the seasons would keep turning. Every sunrise shows he keeps his word.
kjv: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

text: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
meaning: If God gave up his own Son for you, you can trust he won’t hold back anything you truly need.
kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

text: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
meaning: Look back over the year: the harvests, the good days and the gifts all show God’s generous hand.
kjv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

text: Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.
meaning: Be generous with mercy and help, not stingy: the way you treat others is the way you’ll be treated.
kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
meaning: Loving God while being content with what you have is worth more than any amount of money.
kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

text: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.”
meaning: When life doesn’t make sense, remember God sees far more than you do and his plans run deeper.
kjv: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

text: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
meaning: Out of Jesus’ endless supply, you receive one gift of grace after another, wave after wave.
kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

text: You will have plenty to eat, and be satisfied, and will praise the name of the LORD, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.
meaning: After the locusts, God promised Israel full tables again: a picture of how he can restore what was lost.
kjv: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

text: He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
meaning: Generous people who share with those in need are blessed. Open hands make for a full heart.
kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
meaning: Jesus gave up heaven’s riches and became poor so you could be rich in what really lasts.
kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

text: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.
meaning: His power at work in you can do far more than you’d dare to ask or even imagine. Give him the glory.
kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us, Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

text: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works, not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.
meaning: Don’t drift away from other believers. Show up, cheer each other on and spur one another to love.
kjv: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

text: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
meaning: Life is better with people who can pick you up when you fall, so don’t try to go it alone.
kjv: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

text: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
meaning: Help carry what’s crushing the people around you. That’s what living like Jesus looks like.
kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.
meaning: Even a tiny group praying together isn’t small to Jesus: he is right there with them.
kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

text: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
meaning: Good friends make each other better, sometimes through honest words that sharpen you.
kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

text: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
meaning: Show up for people in their best and worst moments: celebrate with them and cry with them.
kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

text: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
meaning: Use your words and time to lift others up. Encouragement is something every believer can give.
kjv: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

text: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
meaning: A real friend’s love doesn’t switch off when life gets hard. Hard times are when they show up most.
kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

text: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
meaning: The early church stuck together: learning, eating, praying and sharing life. It’s still a good pattern.
kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

text: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
meaning: Before you speak or post, ask whether your words will build someone up or tear them down.
kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
meaning: There’s something beautiful about people living in harmony instead of constant conflict.
kjv: A Song of degrees of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

text: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
meaning: Believers are like one body: when one of you hurts, everyone feels it, and when one wins, all celebrate.
kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
meaning: Let Jesus’ words fill your life so you can teach, encourage and sing with each other from the heart.
kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

text: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
meaning: Lots of shallow friends can leave you empty, but one loyal friend can be closer than family.
kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

text: As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
meaning: Treat people the way you wish they’d treat you, even before they do it first.
kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

text: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
meaning: Open your door and your table to others, and do it gladly, not with a sigh.
kjv: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

text: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
meaning: You’re far stronger with people beside you. A rope of three strands is hard to snap.
kjv: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

text: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
meaning: Jesus welcomed you as you were, so welcome others the same way, even those who are different.
kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

text: Let brotherly love continue. Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
meaning: Keep loving each other and be kind to strangers. You never know who you’re really welcoming.
kjv: Let brotherly love continue. Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

text: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
meaning: Pray for everyone, even the people in charge, and thank God for them, so life can be calm and peaceful.
kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men; For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

text: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
meaning: Kind words are like honey: they lift someone’s spirit and can even help them feel better.
kjv: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

text: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
meaning: Whenever you get the chance, do good to everyone, and take special care of your church family.
kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

text: The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
meaning: When you help someone overlooked or in need, Jesus says you’re doing it for him.
kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

text: Moreover as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.
meaning: Samuel saw it as wrong to stop praying for his people. Praying for others is a way to love them.
kjv: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
meaning: A calm, gentle reply can cool down an argument, while a harsh one pours fuel on the fire.
kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

text: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
meaning: Paul’s parting words: be joyful, grow, encourage each other and live in peace, and God will be with you.
kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

text: Rejoice always. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
meaning: Joy, constant prayer and thankfulness in every situation are what God wants for your everyday life.
kjv: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

text: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
meaning: Today is a gift from God, not just another day to get through. Find a reason to be glad in it.
kjv: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
meaning: Your schoolwork, job and conversations can all be done for Jesus, with a thankful heart toward God.
kjv: And what soever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

text: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
meaning: Praise isn’t only for church: it’s you telling yourself to thank God with everything you are.
kjv: A Psalm of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
meaning: Paul wrote this from prison: joy in the Lord doesn’t depend on your circumstances.
kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

text: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
meaning: Thank God, talk to him, and don’t keep it to yourself: tell others what he has done.
kjv: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

text: LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
meaning: His goodness isn’t random. God’s wonderful work comes from plans he made long ago and keeps faithfully.
kjv: O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him, rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
meaning: Keep growing in Jesus the way you started: roots going deeper, faith getting stronger, thanks overflowing.
kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

text: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
meaning: Faith isn’t just theory. Try trusting God and experience for yourself how good he is.
kjv: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

text: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
meaning: Some gifts are too big for words, and God’s gift of Jesus is the greatest one of all.
kjv: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

text: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
meaning: Praise is something you can offer God anytime with your words, even when it takes effort.
kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

text: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
meaning: Like a bride or groom dressed for their wedding, God clothes his people in salvation and joy.
kjv: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

text: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
meaning: Stop and remember the big things God has done for you. Gladness grows when you look back.
kjv: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
meaning: Let God’s peace be the referee in your heart and relationships, and keep a thankful attitude.
kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

text: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.
meaning: When you’ve eaten well, don’t forget the Giver. Thank God for the good things he provides.
kjv: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name. For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
meaning: Come to God with thanks first. His love lasts forever and his faithfulness reaches every generation.
kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name. For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

text: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
meaning: God’s goodness isn’t a mood that changes: his loyal love lasts forever, and that’s worth thanking him for.
kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

text: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
meaning: When God does something great in your life, sing about it and let the world hear.
kjv: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

text: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
meaning: God leads his people in Christ’s victory, and your life can spread the sweet scent of knowing him.
kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

text: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
meaning: Thank God with your whole heart, not halfway, and keep telling others the amazing things he’s done.
kjv: To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David. I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

text: Now therefore, our God, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.
meaning: After his people gave generously, David turned it all into thanks: everything good starts with God.
kjv: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

text: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
meaning: Make a habit of recalling God’s kindness out loud. Remembering his goodness builds hope.
kjv: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

text: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
meaning: Everything comes from God, holds together through him and points back to him. He gets the glory.
kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

text: Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!
meaning: All honor belongs to God because he made everything. You exist because he wanted you to.
kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
meaning: Paul bursts into praise for God: the forever King who can’t die, can’t be seen and is perfectly wise.
kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

text: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy, to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
meaning: God can keep you from falling away and one day bring you into his presence with joy, without fault.
kjv: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

text: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
meaning: After a long season of pain, God’s first word to his people was comfort, and he still speaks it.
kjv: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
meaning: The peace Jesus gives doesn’t depend on everything going right, so your heart doesn’t have to panic.
kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

text: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
meaning: When your mind stays fixed on trusting God, he guards you with a peace that goes deeper than worry.
kjv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

text: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. Those who lived in the land of the shadow of death, on them the light has shined.
meaning: No matter how dark things have been, God’s light can break through. Hope has already dawned.
kjv: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

text: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
meaning: The same God whose voice shakes storms gives his people strength and the gift of peace.
kjv: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

text: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
meaning: You can’t control how others act, but do your part to keep the peace with everyone.
kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

text: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
meaning: Sharing good news about God makes you a welcome messenger. Even tired, dusty feet look beautiful.
kjv: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

text: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
meaning: A peaceful heart brings life, while envy and comparison eat you up from the inside.
kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
meaning: However dark the world gets, the light of Jesus keeps shining, and darkness can’t put it out.
kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

text: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.
meaning: Coming home from exile, God’s people would know such joy that even the hills and trees would seem to sing.
kjv: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
meaning: Paul’s short prayer works as a blessing for you too: may the God who gives peace stay close to you.
kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
meaning: Making peace between people, not stirring up drama, shows the family resemblance to God.
kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

text: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
meaning: Any peace or good you have achieved is ultimately God’s work in you, so you can rest in him.
kjv: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
meaning: Following Jesus means you don’t have to stumble around in the dark. He lights the way forward.
kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

text: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
meaning: Loving God’s ways brings a deep, steady peace that helps keep you from tripping up.
kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

text: Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you.
meaning: Get up and shine: God’s light has come on you, and it’s meant to be seen.
kjv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

text: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
meaning: Peacemakers plant seeds: when you sow peace, a harvest of goodness grows over time.
kjv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

text: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel”; which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
meaning: Immanuel says it all: God didn’t stay distant. In Jesus he came to be with us.
kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

text: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
meaning: This promised child would carry God’s rule and bring true peace: wise, mighty, fatherly and forever.
kjv: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

text: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people. For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.”
meaning: The angel’s news was for everyone: a Savior had been born, so there was no need to be afraid.
kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

text: Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.
meaning: At Jesus’ birth, heaven broke into praise: glory to God and peace offered to people on earth.
kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

text: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
meaning: Rather than just sending a message, God became human in Jesus and lived among us, full of grace and truth.
kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
meaning: The wise men’s long search ended in overflowing joy. Seeking Jesus is worth the journey.
kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

text: The work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
meaning: Living right leads to real peace, along with a quiet confidence that lasts.
kjv: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

text: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
meaning: Instead of fighting over small stuff, chase what brings peace and helps others grow stronger.
kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
meaning: In God, mercy and truth don’t compete. Doing right and living at peace go together like an embrace.
kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

text: The LORD bless you, and keep you. The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.
meaning: This ancient blessing shows God’s heart for you: protection, kindness, his attention and his peace.
kjv: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
meaning: Paul’s closing prayer fits every day: real peace from the Lord himself, at all times and in every way.
kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
